record_type_quote: We tried to reproduce the mixed-design ANOVA result of the Sound Priming x Information Type or the interaction on the toaster preference. We acquired the data from the linked repository, however, no analysis scripts were available, therefore, we tried to repeat the analysis according to the manuscript. We managed to load SAS type data set into R, we followed the exclusion criteria (we managed to remove the 5 participants as described in the manuscript), and we believe that we identified the correct variables (however, the data documentation was very poor – only variable names). We performed the mixed ANOVA and we did not manage to obtain the corresponding results. We further found that we are unable to obtain individual condition means that would correspond to those reported in the manuscript. After those mishaps we terminated the analysis attempt.

targets.outcome_robustness_quote: We proceeded as previously, up to the point of fitting the mixed-design ANOVA model. Instead of using the aggregated measure of preference, we tested each of the 5 subscales separately. However, neither of the specifications resulted in a result that would reproduce the original study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original author data produced comparable numerical output, but the focal interaction was F=1.157, p=.335 rather than F=3.47, p=.01. Analyses of each of five related dependent-variable subscales also did not recover the finding; poor variable documentation limits interpretation.
